notes: Taḥwīl «ح» joins two branches that each write «أبو إسحاق» (or «أبي إسحاق») before the same continuation
«قال سألت الأسود بن يزيد عما حدثته عائشة» is the same Abu Ishaq who asked (rule 5, rule 7 one link), then Aswad, then Aisha, the source of the saying; the Prophet is not written
The first branch's «أبو إسحاق» and the second's «أبي إسحاق» are kept as written, not merged (rule 9)
